desc: The Tipton Best Gun Vise 360 sets the benchmark for firearm maintenance and care. Born from Tipton’s legacy of developing premium gun vises, the Best Gun Vise 360 redefines versatility, innovation, and precision in firearm support. Engineered with an ingenious ball head design, the Tipton Best Gun Vise 360 boasts unrivaled adaptability, effortlessly accommodating any conceivable orientation. Whether you are mounting an optic, conducting general maintenance, or cleaning your firearm, this vise is sure to adapt to your needs. Crafted with the utmost attention to detail, the vise’s multiple sets of non-marring jaw pads ensure your firearm’s finish remains in pristine condition, preserving its value and aesthetics. The Best Gun Vise 360 offers two versatile mounting options – making installation a breeze. Seamlessly integrate it into your workspace by mounting it directly to your benchtop for a stable and permanent solution. Alternatively, take your vise wherever you go by utilizing removable c-clamps (not included) for a secure, portable setup. Whether you’re a professional gunsmith or just a firearm enthusiast, the Tipton Best Gun Vise 360 is a must have addition to your workbench.
